subject: Taxes
title: Portugal: The Former Crypto Haven
description: Learn Portugal: The Former Crypto Haven in one minute.

hook.text: Until 2023, Portugal charged zero tax on personal crypto gains.

buildup.text: Portugal's exemption was unique in Europe. No capital gains tax on crypto held by individuals.

discovery.text: In 2023, Portugal introduced a 28% capital gains tax on crypto held under a year. The paradise closed.

twist.text: Crypto held over a year in Portugal is still tax-free.

climax.text: Portugal's reversal shows that crypto tax havens are temporary.

punchline.text: Zero to 28% overnight. Crypto tax havens always have an expiration date.

quiz.question: What happened to Portugal's crypto tax exemption?
options: A 28% tax was introduced for holdings under a year in 2023
